questions.stem: A 60-year-old man came to the Ophthalmology OPD with complaints of a diminution of vision. He was a daily wage worker who works in a factory and does welding mainly. He is also a chronic smoker. The patient also claims that he can read the newspaper without his reading glasses which was not possible until recently. Which among the following statements about the Diagnosis is NOT TRUE?

options.label: A
options.text: The above diagnosis is Nuclear Cataract

options.label: B
options.text: The central fibres harden while the cortical fibres are relatively unaffected

options.label: C
options.text: The colour of the nucleus becomes dark due to pigmented protein deposition

options.label: D
options.text: Near vision is improved because of progressive Hypermetropia
